definitions.gloss: bamboo pole; long bamboo stick used for hanging laundry or as a tool
definitions.explanation: A long pole made of bamboo, traditionally used for hanging laundry to dry outdoors. Also used for reaching high places, fishing, and other purposes.

examples.japanese: {竿竹|さおだけ}に{洗濯物|せんたくもの}を{干|ほ}す。
examples.english: To hang laundry on a bamboo pole.

examples.japanese: {古|ふる}くなった{竿竹|さおだけ}を{新|あたら}しいものに{交換|こうかん}した。
examples.english: I replaced the old bamboo pole with a new one.

examples.japanese: {住宅街|じゅうたくがい}を「{竿竹|さおだけ}ー、{竿竹|さおだけ}ー」と{売|う}り{歩|ある}くトラックの{声|こえ}が{聞|き}こえてきた。
examples.english: I could hear the voice from a truck going through the residential area selling bamboo poles, calling out 'Saodake, saodake.'

notes:
A compound of {竿|さお} (pole, rod) + {竹|たけ} (bamboo). In Japan, outdoor laundry drying using {竿竹|さおだけ} or metal poles is still the norm in many households. Modern laundry poles are often made of stainless steel or aluminum rather than actual bamboo, but the word {竿竹|さおだけ} persists.

CULTURAL NOTE:
The {竿竹|さおだけ}{屋|や} (bamboo pole seller) is a distinctive feature of Japanese neighborhoods — trucks slowly drive through residential areas broadcasting recorded calls of 「{竿竹|さおだけ}ー」 to sell replacement laundry poles. The book 『なぜ、あの{竿竹|さおだけ}{屋|や}はつぶれないのか？』 became a bestselling business book exploring why this seemingly unprofitable business model survives.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {竿竹|さおだけ}に{干|ほ}す: to hang (laundry) on a bamboo pole
- {竿竹|さおだけ}{屋|や}: bamboo pole seller
- {物干|ものほ}し{竿|ざお}: clothes-drying pole (synonym)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {物干|ものほ}し{竿|ざお}: clothes-drying pole — the general term for a laundry pole, regardless of material
- {竹竿|たけざお}: bamboo pole — same characters reversed; more general, not specifically for laundry
- {竿|さお}: pole; rod — the base word, also used for fishing rods
